subject: Cloud marketplace listing fees: prioritization & PR credit request
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cloud marketplace listing fees: prioritization & PR credit request

Team — forwarding the vendor invoices and marketplace fee summary we just received from AWS and GCP. TL;DR: both vendors are asking to renew listing fees and update our co-sell eligibility paperwork by end of Q4. We have limited PR/coop budget to offset first-year listing costs.

Attachments: [redwood-marketplace-fees-2026.xlsx] (breakdown by SKU, estimated first-year listing fee, and co-marketing asks)

Ask: please review and tell me: 1) which marketplace (AWS vs GCP) we prioritize for a one-time credit request, 2) whether finance can pre-approve a holdback from PR budget to cover the remainder, and 3) if Partnerships can push for fee waiver in exchange for a joint case study/co-marketing commitment.

Suggested timeline: decide by EOD 10/13 so I can send the ask to AWS/GCP partner leads and get a response before their renewal windows close.

Next steps I propose: Marissa — lead partner negotiations and draft a simple win-win ask; Karthik — help prioritize by ARR funnel impact and customer signals; Marcus — indicate provisional budget headroom for PR credits.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud marketplace listing fees: prioritization & PR credit request

Thanks Evelyn — quick read. I pulled ARR and pipeline touchpoints for accounts that surfaced via marketplace discovery over the last 12 months. My recommendation: score each marketplace by two axes — (a) incremental ARR influenced by marketplace listings over past 6 months, and (b) strategic reach (eligibility for co-sell / marketplace marketing). I attached a one-page prioritization template that maps to those axes.

Attachment: [marketplace-prioritization-template-v1.docx]

If we weight ARR impact 60% and strategic reach 40%, AWS looks higher today because of our Gov and infra customers. GCP is stronger for ML-native customers and Embedding-heavy workloads, but the listing fee there is smaller. If Partnerships can secure a full or partial listing waiver with a co-marketing commitment, that changes the calc.

Karthik
Head of Sales Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: amy.chou@amazon.com, gcp-partner@google.com
Date: 2026-10-11T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud marketplace listing fees: prioritization & PR credit request

Looping in external partners so they see we're moving. Amy / GCP partner — quick context: Redwood is evaluating which marketplace to prioritize for a one-time listing-credit request. We can offer a short-term co-marketing plan (webinar + case study + one email blast) if the marketplace provider will waive or rebate the first-year listing fee.

Negotiation levers I plan to use: waived first-year listing fee, redirected coop funds into marketplace promo, and a 6–8 week go-to-market rapid campaign that demonstrates measurable leads back to the marketplace listing. If the vendor needs proof of pipeline influence, Karthik can share the ARR-attributed list.

Evelyn — I can draft an ask template to send to Amy and the GCP rep today. Marcus — please confirm whether finance will allow a fallback from Q4 PR funds if the vendor declines the ask.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Amy Chou <amy.chou@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, Oct 9, 2026 at 10:02 AM
Subject: AWS listing fee window
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Hi Marissa — quick note: we do have limited discretionary credits for qualifying ISVs in October–November. Credits are prioritized for partners who commit to a joint webinar + a marketplace launch banner. Send a one-pager and we can evaluate.
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud marketplace listing fees: prioritization & PR credit request

I can provisionally approve up to $60,000 from the FY26 PR/marketing bucket to cover listing fees contingent on Finance signing off on a short memo: purpose, expected KPIs (leads / MQLs), and vendor billing terms (PO vs invoice). We need the following before I greenlight: vendor legal name for the PO, SOW or invoice sample, and the HubSpot campaign ID to tie spend to outcomes.

If Partnerships secures a vendor credit that covers >=50% of the fee, we can reallocate the remainder to developer community events instead.

Marcus Lin
Director, Finance (Rev Ops partner)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud marketplace listing fees: prioritization & PR credit request

Quick legal note: marketplace fee waivers and co-marketing commitments are straightforward, but we need standard language around deliverables and approval windows. If AWS/GCP request exclusivity or extended promotional placement, we should push back or price-adjust. Also, confirm whether the listing fee is capitalizable or OPEX for accounting classification — Marcus, will need your call on that.

Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Commercial
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: amy.chou@amazon.com, gcp-partner@google.com, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-10-13T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud marketplace listing fees: prioritization & PR credit request — decision & next steps

Thanks all for the quick responses. Summary and decisions: 
1) Prioritization: AWS gets priority this cycle based on Karthik's ARR weighting and the discretionary credit window Amy called out.
2) Finance: Marcus will provisionally reserve up to $60k from PR budget pending the memo + vendor invoice sample.
3) Partnerships: Marissa to send a one-pager ask to Amy (AWS) today offering a webinar + case study in exchange for a full or partial listing credit. Marissa — please cc me on the outgoing ask and paste the HubSpot campaign ID when available.
4) Legal: Jonas to prepare standard co-marketing language and ensure there's no exclusivity clause that limits our other marketplace activity.

Action items: 
- Marissa: send ask to Amy and GCP rep, attach the one-pager, request credit amount and timeline (due 10/22).
- Karthik: share the ARR-influenced account list (by EOD 10/12).
- Marcus: confirm accounting classification and send memo template for Finance sign-off (by 10/15).

I'll follow up with a DocuSign for the joint marketing commitment if the vendor agrees to a waiver.

Evelyn Hart
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood-marketplace-fees-2026.xlsx]
[Attachment: marketplace-prioritization-template-v1.docx]
